invariant: The conformance preflight must execute the admitted upstream test subset under the suite's own working-directory convention. Upstream suites legitimately anchor fixture paths either at the repository root or at the real-cased test root; the harness probes these admitted roots in a deterministic order and records the satisfying root instead of guessing one convention. The bar is unchanged: the selected nodes must pass unmodified, dependencies are never auto-installed, and a subset failing under every admitted root is still rejected at materialization.
